text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Excessive administration of Ringer’s Injection can cause: Hyperkalemia and hypernatremia, especially in patients with severe renal impairment. Fluid overload (which can lead to pulmonary and/or peripheral edema). Hypercalcemia Overdose interventions include Ringer’s Injection discontinuation, treatment of electrolyte imbalances, and close monitoring of fluid balance and electrolyte concentrations [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.4 , 5.5 , 5.6 , 5.7 )].
